name: Vex Major
description: Vex Major, also known as Far Gent, was a swampy Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Moddell sector. Originally settled by a sect of the Order of the Ffib, by the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War decades later Vex Major was inhabited by insular clans of Human fishers.
lead_paragraphs: Vex Major, also known as Far Gent, was a swampy Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Moddell sector. Originally settled by a sect of the Order of the Ffib, by the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War decades later Vex Major was inhabited by insular clans of Human fishers.
